taste:
This is a substantial roast chicken meal with a bright lemon and herb flavour. The marinade combines fresh lemon with fragrant herbs, giving the meat a zesty, aromatic character rather than relying on richness alone. Citrus notes cut through that richness, while the chicken is described as succulent and tender. Golden skin adds another texture, though the description does not establish how crisp it will be.

Chips and crunchy coleslaw complete the plate. The coleslaw provides the clearest textural contrast to the tender meat, while the generous chips help make it a hearty meal. It is served hot, with the lemon and herbs giving the chicken a fresh-tasting finish.
